name: comp-485
title: Filterable Data Table
description: A complete people-management table. It searches by name or email, filters by status, hides columns, sorts, selects rows for bulk delete and pages through results.
use: A back-office screen must let staff find, filter, sort and bulk-edit a list of people or records.
avoid: It loads demo data from a public URL and exposes no props, so wiring real data means editing the component.
a11y: Sortable headers are keyboard operable and the row count is announced, but the row menu is labelled Edit item although it holds many actions. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark admin table under a toolbar with a search field, Status and View buttons and a right-aligned Add user button. The header row holds a select-all checkbox plus Name, Email, Location, Status, Performance and Balance, and each row ends in a three-dot menu. Row count and pager sit below.
behaves: Typing in the search box narrows rows by name or email and adds a clear icon. Status opens a checklist of statuses with counts, View toggles columns, clicking a header sorts, and row checkboxes reveal a Delete button that confirms first.
customise: Columns, cell rendering, the demo fetch URL and all toolbar copy live in the file; real data and extra props require source edits.
weight: moderate: Ten visible rows plus sort, filter and pagination logic from TanStack; no animation loop.
demo: Ten staff rows such as Alex Alan, Anna Vissotski and Fatima Al-Sayed, with cities, statuses and balances.
issues: Row action button is labelled Edit item though it opens a multi-action menu.
Data comes from a public URL, so the table shows No results until the fetch loads.
polishWhy: Complete and consistent admin table; tiny type and a crowded toolbar hold it back.
